preamble: Palatalization of the voiced velar stop [g] to the voiced alveolo-palatal affricate [dʑ] before front vowels and glides, without devoicing. It is characteristic of Wu Chinese, which keeps the Middle Chinese voiced (murmured) obstruents: Middle Chinese 群 [g] before [i, y] is [dʑ] in Shanghainese, whereas Mandarin, Gan and New Xiang devoiced it to [tɕ] or [tɕʰ].

examples.note: Wu retains the voiced initial while palatalizing it before the front glide.
